subject: Request: Veridian Labs private hosting + limited audit window
messages:
From: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@veridianlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Veridian Procurement <procurement@veridianlabs.com>, Anya Kline <anya.kline@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment — audit window & KMS/egress constraints

Mina —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Veridian is ready to move forward with a pilot but we have three non-negotiable requirements for any private/VPC/on-prem deployment: 

1) Audit window limited to a maximum of 7 calendar days per year and all audits must be performed remotely unless explicitly agreed for a single, scheduled on-site visit. No continuous access.
2) KMS must remain customer-controlled (HSM preferred) and we require that tokenization/keys never leave our boundary. We will accept a tightly-scoped escrow arrangement, but only for forensic events with mutual agreement.
3) Strict egress constraints: no outbound logs containing customer PII. Any aggregated telemetry must be reviewable by Veridian legal prior to export.

Commercial ask: to accept these constraints we are requesting a 40% upfront discount on list for a 3-year committed pilot (annual payment). We are a strategic target (long-term roadmap integration) and can prioritize Redwood as a standard stack if these terms are in place.

Attached is a short SOW draft. Can you confirm what concessions Redwood can make and the fastest path to exec sign-off?

Regards,
Rajesh Patel
VP, Cloud & Infrastructure | Veridian Labs
r.patel@veridianlabs.com

Attachments: Veridian_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Veridian Procurement <procurement@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — audit window & KMS/egress constraints

Rajesh —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the SOW. Really appreciate the urgency. We're interested in making Veridian a reference customer for private deployments — the ask is operationally significant but potentially doable with guardrails. I need to escalate a few specifics internally (security, legal, and deal desk).

Quick clarifying questions that will speed review:
- For the audit window: is the 7-day limit per calendar year strict, or would you consider 14 days if remote-only and with 30 days advance notice?
- For KMS: can Veridian share whether HSM is available in-cloud (BYOK in your KMS) vs fully on-prem HSM? This affects our deployment model and whether we can support encrypted backups out of band.
- For egress: can you provide examples of telemetry you consider acceptable vs unacceptable? Our security team usually shares a redaction matrix to confirm.

I'll loop in Marissa and Jonas for commercial latitude and Laura for a security quick-take. Expect an internal reply within one business day.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: dealdesk@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Escalation: Veridian Labs — request for private hosting carveouts and 40% discount (SOW attached)

Team —

Summary: Veridian (large enterprise prospect) is requesting private/VPC hosting with three restrictive clauses (audit window limited to 7 days/year, customer-controlled KMS/HSM with no key egress, and strict no-PII egress). In return they're asking for 40% off list for a 3-year commit (annual billing). Attached SOW v1.

What I'm asking for: quick guidance from commercial & legal/security tolerance. My proposed counter (to get to yes quickly):
- Discount: up to 30% for a 2-year committed pilot (annual payment), subject to prepay-first-year or a 12-month minimum revenue guarantee.
- Audit window: allow 14 days/year remote audits only, with 30 days advance notice; additional on-site audits require separate agreement and reimbursement.
- KMS: support BYOK with customer-managed keys for tokenization; absolute prohibition on key export — require escrow only for clearly-defined forensic events and only after mutual signed authorization.
- Egress/logging: we will provide a redaction matrix and allow Veridian legal review of exported telemetry prior to sharing; PII must be hashed/tokenized in-line per SOW.

Risks / notes: support and infra teams flag increased operational overhead for fully disconnected HSMs and strict audit constraints. This may require a higher SLA or a staged operational runbook (we will bill for additional runbook/on-call support).

Attachments: Veridian_SOW_v1.pdf, security_requirements_matrix.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Veridian-Labs-98765

Can we get a yes/no on the discount band and audit/KMS posture today? Time-sensitive — they want signature within a week.

Thanks,
Mina
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, legal_ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Veridian Labs — request for private hosting carveouts and 40% discount (SOW attached)

Mina / Marissa —

Thanks for the succinct escalation. Given Veridian's strategic potential, I will approve a pathway to close with the following conditions: 

1) Commercial: authorize up to 25% discount for a 2-year committed pilot (annual payment), but only if Veridian prepays the first 12 months or posts a 12-month ARR guarantee. No 3-year 40% concession.

2) Audit posture: accept 14 days/year for remote audits with 30 days notice. Any on-site visits require explicit exec sign-off and reimbursement of reasonable costs; we reserve the right to redact Redwood internal metrics.

3) KMS & egress: we will support BYOK with customer-managed HSM where keys never leave the customer boundary. Escrow can be permitted for forensics but must be narrowly scoped, court-ordered, or mutually agreed with a signed trigger.

4) Operations cost: due to expected higher ops support, require an add-on 'private-hosting runbook & standby' fee (one-time onboarding + monthly support line item); details to be finalized by Ops (copied Laura).

Laura — please confirm security/legal can sign off on the above language and provide any mandatory SOW text (audit notice, redaction rights, escrow trigger language) by EOD tomorrow. Marissa — once Laura signs off, confirm the final commercial offer and I'll authorize legal to execute.

Jonas Weber
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@veridianlabs.com>, Anya Kline <anya.kline@veridianlabs.com>, Veridian Procurement <procurement@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, legal_ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — audit window & KMS/egress constraints

Rajesh / Anya —

Appreciate your patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: Redwood can move forward with a pilot under the following mutually-agreed concessions (summary):

- Commercial: 25% discount off list for a 2-year pilot, contingent on Veridian prepaying the first 12 months or providing a 12-month ARR guarantee (per Jonas).
- Audit window: remote audits only, up to 14 calendar days per year with 30 days advance notice. Any on-site visits require exec approval and reimbursement of reasonable travel/handling costs.
- KMS/keys: we will support BYOK and customer-managed HSMs. Keys will not be exported from Veridian under normal operations. Key escrow allowed only for defined forensic triggers and requires mutual written authorization.
- Egress/logging: PII must be tokenized/hashed in-line and cannot be exported. Redwood will supply a redaction matrix and allow Veridian legal to review exported telemetry prior to release.
- Operations: a one-time onboarding runbook & standby fee will be added to the SOW to cover the operational overhead of the constrained hosting model.

Next steps: I've attached an updated SOW and the security requirements matrix. If this aligns with Veridian, sign the DocuSign (link below) and we'll provision a pilot environment. Legal will follow with the precise contract language for escrow triggers and audit notice obligations.

DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.net/verify/ABC123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Veridian-Labs-98765

Thanks — looking forward to getting Veridian onboarded.

Best,
Mina Haddad
